item.title: Oil prices plunge and stocks soar after U.S. and Iran agree on a ceasefire
item.summary: Investors around the world breathed a sigh of relief at the prospect of peace — and an easing of the global energy crisis.

item.title: The U.S. and Iran agree to a 2-week ceasefire but some attacks continue
item.summary: Iran and the U.S. and Israel said they would suspend strikes but countries in the region continued to report attacks and Israel said it would not stop its assault in Lebanon.

item.title: Abortion clinics are closing nationwide. Could urgent care help fill the gap?
item.summary: When the only clinic that offered abortions in Michigan's rural Upper Peninsula closed, an urgent care decided to step in to fill the gap. Now, others are considering similar moves as brick-and-mortar clinics close in blue states.

item.title: 11 new books in April offer a chance to step inside someone else's world
item.summary: The books we're spotlighting this month don't exactly radiate escapist good vibes — but they do offer the opportunity to step into someone else's life and get to know their view of our shared world.

item.title: Democrats keep doing better in elections since Trump returned to office
item.summary: With elections in Georgia and Wisconsin Tuesday, Democrats continued to overperform, which the party started in 2025 when it regularly improved on its margins compared to the presidential race in 2024.

item.title: Colleges are trying to boost student voting. A Trump probe freezes data for that work
item.summary: To figure out how to boost student voting, colleges have relied on a study about campus voter registration and turnout rates. A Trump administration investigation has cut schools off from new data.

item.title: Your sarcasm is showing — and its history is surprisingly violent
item.summary: Some people use sarcasm jokingly. But funnily enough, we tend not to find it witty when we're on the receiving end.

item.title: Telehealth abortion will remain available for now, after a federal judge's ruling
item.summary: The abortion pill mifepristone must undergo a safety review by the FDA, the judge said. Louisiana's case seeking to ban its use through telemedicine will proceed after that review.

item.title: Netflix does Nordic noir right in 'Jo Nesbø's Detective' series
item.summary: A tortured Oslo police detective may be on the trail of a psycho killer in this genuinely suspenseful screen adaptation of Jo Nesbø's The Devil's Star.

item.title: The Artemis II crew saw parts of the moon never seen before. Here's what they said
item.summary: The astronauts on Artemis II observed parts of the moon humans had never seen before. Their findings provide a scientific baseline — and sense of wonder — for future missions.
